title.en: Patient stylists praised by regular clients

text.en: Clients speak warmly of the salon team at Sports Arena Blvd, specifically commending stylists Eric, Christina, and Ashley for their courteous assistance. Pet owners highlight that groomers listen attentively to pet needs, though one visitor reported poor communication from a new stylist during a booking.

title.en: Clean coats and tidy breed haircuts

text.en: Most reviewers express satisfaction with the styling outcomes, reporting fresh coats, thorough de-shedding, and clean teeth and nails. While one customer experienced an uneven haircut and missed matting on a pedigree dog, the majority of clients describe consistent trimming and pleasant bath finishes.

Pet parents often note how calmly stylists manage older, arthritic dogs and anxious rescue animals. Reviewers appreciate that groomers take time to steady large breeds like Saint Bernards and work gently around sore joints, allowing vulnerable pets to complete their grooming routine comfortably.

q.en: Can large and nervous rescue dogs be groomed here?

a.en: Yes, clients report that stylists handle large breeds and anxious rescue dogs with patience and gentle reassurance.

q.en: Are express appointments or quick services available?

a.en: Reviewers note that routine baths, nail trims, and teeth brushing can be completed promptly when booked in advance.

q.en: Can owners request specific pet stylists?

a.en: Yes, returning customers frequently mention scheduling appointments directly with preferred groomers.

q.en: Do stylists groom senior pets with mobility challenges?

a.en: Yes, reviewers mention that staff show particular care and compassion when trimming elderly dogs suffering from severe arthritis.
